name: When is a handrail required by building codes?

mainEntity.name: When is a handrail required by building codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building codes typically mandate handrails on stairs and ramps when there are a certain number of risers or a specific change in elevation. For residential properties, a handrail is generally required if there are four or more risers. Commercial properties often have stricter requirements, sometimes needing handrails on both sides of a staircase. Guardrails are required for elevated surfaces like balconies or decks over a certain height. Specific requirements can vary slightly by local jurisdiction, so it's essential to consult with a contractor familiar with Bay Area codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Handrails are generally required on stairs with four or more risers and on ramps to meet building codes, especially in the Bay Area.
